findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): false positive keyword matches
findings.evidence: ToolsHubScreen.kt:374 and DocumentsScreenPreview.kt:24 contain Portuguese 'dobrável' in preview labels; quality_tools_strings.xml:35 contains 'dobra' for book-page curvature. The substring dob does not denote date of birth or other personal data.
findings.recommendation: Do not declare other personal information based on these matches.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): no audio collection in supplied sources
findings.evidence: RewardedAdManager.kt:190 calls recordAdShown with an ad identifier; ToolAdAccessStore.kt:89 implements it as Unit. BackupHistoryRepository.kt:10 records backup history entries and its delete documentation explicitly describes a local record. None of these record occurrences captures voice or sound.
findings.recommendation: Do not declare audio based on these false positive keyword matches; review advertising metadata separately.
